mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% consistently compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad consumer spending contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 110 indicates robust supply chain activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth below 50,000 jobs signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 50.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 360,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises.
